messages:
elaine: Following up on the streaming postmortem. Hotfixes deployed but we need owners and timelines for followups (timeouts, partials, reconnects).
devin: Good call. Can you list the items?
elaine: Short list: 1) SDK client backoff defaults, 2) server resume handshake and short-lived KV retention, 3) prefix cache TTL audit + extra logs, 4) scheduled regression job to catch partial responses, 5) dashboard heatmap + weekly digest for recurrence.
omar: I can own (3) prefix cache audit. ETA: Friday EOD. Need a quick infra quota review.
tess: I will own (4) regression job. Plan: extend the stream-eval harness to run randomized chunk sizes + network jitter nightly. Target: next Tuesday.
devin: I'll take (1) SDK backoff bump. PR today, release tomorrow. Backoff: exp from 150ms to 8s with jitter.
oncall-lee: ops-bot shows a recurring tail in eu-west-1 around 02:50-03:20 UTC. I'll add an autoscale correlation panel and a regional heatmap.
ops-bot: Alert log: streaming-timeout-rate peaked at 3.9% on 2026-03-10T02:57:00Z (threshold 1%).
elaine: For (2) resume handshake proposal: server keeps KV cache for 3s and accepts resume tokens within that window. Draft spec: internal doc.
omar: Hypothesis: some clients send malformed close frames causing TTLs to be extended. I'll add logging for session_close_reason and kv_ttl_hit and a metric stream_prefix_kv_ttl_miss. Query suggestion: sum(rate(stream_session_close_total{reason!~"normal|client_closed"}[5m])) by (region).
tess: Regression job details: nightly harness runs with 4 randomized jitter profiles. If partial-response rate > 0.5% over 2 hours, auto-create a tracker issue. Repo: internal stream-harness.
devin: SDK note: will add compat notes, CHANGELOG, and announce in #devex.
elaine: Owner recap: (1) devin, (2) eng-runtime (tess to coordinate), (3) omar, (4) tess, (5) oncall-lee.
oncall-lee: I'll create DASH-214 heatmap + weekly digest, and enable slow-trace capture when reconnect latency >2s.
omar: Creating ticket INFR-4192 for prefix cache TTL audit.
tess: Creating STREAM-799 for regression job and tests.
oncall-lee: Creating DASH-214 for dashboard work.
elaine: Timeline summary: SDK release by tomorrow, cache logs by Friday, regression job by next Tue, resume handshake spec review in 48h, dashboards/digest by end of week. Flag any slips here.
devin: :thumbsup:
omar: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar invite: "Streaming reliability follow-up" scheduled 2026-03-25T16:30Z (invite sent).
